about.title: Comprehensive care for Miami and across Florida
about.intro: Sanos Medical Group is a primary care practice dedicated to keeping patients healthy with personalized, evidence-based care, in our Miami office and by virtual visit across Florida.

story.heading: Our story
story.body: Sanos Medical Group was founded to bring accessible, relationship-centered primary care to our community. We focus on building lasting relationships with our patients and caring for the whole person, whether you visit us in Miami or connect by secure video from anywhere in Florida.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body: To provide compassionate, high-quality primary care that helps our community live healthier lives, meeting each patient with respect, clear communication, and care that fits their life.

newPatient.body: Welcome! To make your first visit smooth, arrive about 15 minutes early and bring a photo ID, your insurance card, and a list of the medications and supplements you take. primaryCare.seoDescription: Primary care in Miami and virtual visits across Florida: annual physicals, preventive care, and chronic condition management from licensed providers. Request an appointment.

faqs.q: What happens during an annual physical?
faqs.a: Your provider reviews your health history, checks your vital signs, discusses any concerns, and recommends preventive screenings that fit your age and risk factors. It is also a good time to ask questions and set health goals.

We work with many major insurance plans. Because coverage varies by plan, the fastest way to confirm yours is to contact our office. Our team can verify your benefits before your visit. Self-pay options are also available.

faqs.q: How do I become a new patient?
faqs.a: Submit an appointment request through our contact form and our team will call you to schedule your first visit. Visits are available in person in Miami or by secure video across Florida.

primaryCare.title: Everyday care that grows with you
primaryCare.intro: Your primary care team is your first point of contact for staying healthy and managing concerns as they arise. We focus on prevention, early detection, and a long-term partnership in your care.
features: Chronic disease management (such as diabetes, hypertension, and cholesterol)
Sick visits for acute, non-emergency concerns
Coordination of referrals and specialist care
primaryCare.expectBody: At your visit, your provider reviews your history, listens to your concerns, and works with you on a plan tailored to your needs. We take the time to answer your questions and make sure you feel comfortable with the plan.

labs.seoTitle: Blood Testing & Lab Work in Miami
labs.seoDescription: Convenient in-office blood testing and lab work in Miami. Diagnostic panels and preventive screenings ordered by a licensed provider. Request an appointment.

faqs.q: Do I need to fast before my blood test?
faqs.a: Some tests require fasting and others do not. When your provider orders labs, our team will tell you exactly how to prepare, including whether to fast and for how long.
Samples are collected in-office for your convenience and processed by our laboratory partner. Your provider then reviews the results with you.

faqs.q: How will I get my results?
faqs.a: Your provider reviews your lab results with you and explains what they mean for your care and any next steps. Testing and follow-up are individualized.

labs.title: Testing that helps guide your care
labs.intro: Lab work helps your provider understand your health, catch issues early, and track how a treatment plan is working. We make testing convenient with in-office collection and our partner laboratory.
features: In-office blood draw with a partner laboratory
labs.processBody: Your provider determines which tests are appropriate based on your evaluation. Samples are collected in-office and processed by our laboratory partner. Results are reviewed with you so you understand what they mean for your care. Testing recommendations are individualized. This page does not guarantee specific tests or results.

weightManagement.seoDescription: Medically supervised weight management in Miami: individualized, provider-led plans that combine clinical oversight with lifestyle care. Request an evaluation.

faqs.q: How does the weight-management program work?
faqs.a: Care begins with a clinical evaluation of your health history and goals. Your provider then builds an individualized, supervised plan that combines lifestyle, nutrition, and activity guidance with ongoing follow-up.

faqs.q: Is the program right for me?
faqs.a: Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider based on your individual health profile. The program is not one-size-fits-all, and we do not promise specific outcomes. Your provider will discuss what to expect.
When clinically appropriate, your provider may discuss treatment options, including medication, as one part of a supervised plan. Any medication is prescribed only after an evaluation.

weightManagement.title: Medically supervised weight management
weightManagement.intro: Our weight-management program combines clinical oversight with practical lifestyle support. Care is individualized and begins with a provider evaluation to determine whether the program is appropriate for you.
features: A clinical evaluation of your health history and goals
A discussion of treatment options when clinically appropriate
weightManagement.eligibilityBody: Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider based on your individual health profile. The program is not a one-size-fits-all plan, and we do not promise specific outcomes. Your provider will discuss what to expect and any options that may be appropriate for you.

glp1.seoDescription: Provider-evaluated GLP-1 therapy in Miami, offered as part of a medically supervised weight-management plan. Prescription only, after a clinical evaluation.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for GLP-1 treatment?
faqs.a: GLP-1 medications are prescription only and are considered after a clinical evaluation. A licensed provider determines whether treatment is appropriate for you; it is not guaranteed.

faqs.q: What are common side effects of GLP-1 medications?
faqs.a: Like all medications, GLP-1 treatments can have side effects, which may include nausea and digestive discomfort, among others. Always talk to your provider before starting, changing, or stopping any medication.

faqs.q: How does GLP-1 fit into a weight-management plan?
faqs.a: When appropriate, GLP-1 therapy is offered as one part of a comprehensive, medically supervised plan that also includes lifestyle and nutrition support, with ongoing monitoring.

glp1.title: Medically supervised GLP-1 treatment
glp1.intro: GLP-1 medications may be offered as one part of a comprehensive, medically supervised weight-management plan. They are prescription medications used only after a clinical evaluation and prescribed at the discretion of a licensed provider.
glp1.featuresHeading: How GLP-1 care works with us
features: A clinical evaluation to review your health history and goals
A provider determination of whether treatment is appropriate for you
Integration with lifestyle and nutrition support
Ongoing monitoring and follow-up while in the program
glp1.howBody: GLP-1 medications are prescription medications dispensed only after a clinical evaluation. Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider, and treatment is not guaranteed. Your provider will discuss whether GLP-1 therapy fits your individual plan.
glp1.safetyBody: Like all medications, GLP-1 treatments can have side effects, which may include nausea and digestive discomfort, among others. Your provider will review the potential benefits and risks with you. Always talk to your provider before starting, changing, or stopping any medication.
glp1.fdaNote: We will discuss the specific medication that may be appropriate for you, including its regulatory status, during your evaluation. This page makes no claims about specific brands or FDA-approval status.

privacy.intro:
At Sanos Medical Group, we are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal and health information in compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act ("HIPAA"), Florida law, and other applicable federal and state regulations.

This Privacy Policy and Notice of Privacy Practices explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, communicate with our office, or receive healthcare-related services.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect the following information:

sections.heading: Website usage information
sections.body: When visiting our website, we may automatically collect:

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We may use your information for:
bullets: Providing medical treatment and healthcare services
Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations
sections.note: We will not sell or improperly disclose your protected health information.

sections.heading: Disclosure of information
sections.body: We may disclose your information:
bullets: To healthcare providers involved in your care
To insurance companies for payment purposes
To vendors or service providers performing services on our behalf under HIPAA-compliant agreements
When required by law, court order, or public health reporting requirements
sections.note: All disclosures are made in accordance with applicable privacy laws and HIPAA regulations.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to:
bullets: Request access to your medical records
Request restrictions on certain uses or disclosures
Obtain a copy of this Notice
sections.note: Requests must be submitted in writing to our Privacy Officer.

sections.heading: Website security
sections.body:
We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. However, no electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed 100% secure.

Please avoid submitting sensitive medical information through unsecured email or website contact forms unless specifically instructed by our office.

sections.heading: Cookies & tracking technologies
sections.body:
Our website may use cookies, analytics tools, and related technologies to improve functionality, user experience, and website performance.

You may disable cookies through your browser settings; however, some website features may not function properly.

sections.heading: Third-party links
sections.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites or platforms, including patient portals, telehealth systems, payment processors, or social media platforms. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party websites.

sections.heading: Data breach notification
sections.body: In the event of a breach involving unsecured protected health information, affected individuals will be notified in accordance with HIPAA, Florida law, and applicable federal breach notification requirements.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy and Notice of Privacy Practices at any time. Updated versions will be posted on this website with a revised effective date.

sections.heading: Contact information
sections.body:
If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your privacy rights, please contact:
